# What the security workflows install to check the browser. It is not a
# dependency list for running the browser — install.sh uses your distro's
# packages for that — but the engine version pinned here is the one the
# checks report on, so Dependabot keeps it current and a bump here is the
# signal that a newer Chromium is available.
PyQt6==6.11.0
PyQt6-WebEngine==6.11.0
